pages.name: Gold Beetle
pages.text: Common in mushroom fields. Aggressive, except toward gold wearers.
One beetle in twenty is gold, and it is the only beetle that fights. Its cousins are harmless.$(br2)Wear gold and it will not bite.
$(item)Potion gene$()$(br)A gold beetle can carry a potion effect. Its sting passes the effect on for a few seconds, and the beetle itself becomes immune to potion effects.

$(item)Breeding$()$(br)Gold beetles like golden food and meat, and ignore flowers.$(br2)Two gold beetles have a gold child, and any beetle pair may, one time in a hundred, have one too.$(br2)If both parents share a gene, the child inherits it. Otherwise dose both parents with the same potion, and the child may take one of the effects they share.
